subject: Error in validating latent variables using confirmatory factor analysis

messages.author: 94c422834c6aeb05
messages.subject: Error in validating latent variables using confirmatory factor analysis
parts:
Hi,
I'm a beginner in structural equations.
Before doing structural equations, I want to validate my measurement model (my latent variables). But when I start the factorial analysis, I have an error. I am French and I have difficulty understanding it or finding the solution on the internet. Is there a solution to avoid this error ?

My script :
# Spécification du modèle
model.SPE <- '# Variables latentes
instabilite =~ insta+heb
sm =~ dep+pt
env =~ victim+sentiment'

# Estimation du modèle avec l'estimateur "Robust" WLSMV
model.EST <- cfa(model.SPE, data=base, estimator="WLSMV")

Thank you so much,
Midori

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Error in validating latent variables using confirmatory factor analysis
parts: Is there a solution to avoid this error ?
lavaan WARNING: the optimizer warns that a solution has NOT been found

The estimation algorithm did not converge on a solution.  Because you only have 2 indicators per factor, your model might not be empirically identified unless the factor correlations are substantially nonzero. 

https://psycnet.apa.org/doi/10.1037/1082-989X.7.2.210

Also, you did not declare any of your indicators as ordered= in the cfa() call.  Is their class() already ordered in base?  If the indicators are not ordinal, you should not be requesting estimator="WLSMV".

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Assistant Professor, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
